name: Mike J Mitch (Michael Mitchell)
bioMore: Real name Michael Mitchell. Director and producer with more than a decade of experience in advertising production, winner of Cannes Lions, One Show, Clios, and Webby Awards; his work has been covered by Forbes, Variety, and AdWeek. At Phantom X, known for his strategic use of AI as a production tool — not for novelty, but to expand the possibilities of narrative storytelling. Directed the horror series The Sage, now seven episodes deep.
